segments.name: Container vessels
segments.description: Owns and operates container vessels primarily chartered on multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements to liner companies.
segments.evidence: The container vessels segment owns and operates container vessels which are primarily chartered on multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements.

segments.name: Drybulk vessels
segments.description: Owns and operates drybulk vessels providing drybulk commodities transportation services.
segments.evidence: The drybulk vessels segment owns and operates drybulk vessels to provide drybulk commodities transportation services.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company charter hire under multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements for use of its vessels.
revenueModel.evidence: The container vessels segment owns and operates container vessels which are primarily chartered on multi-year, fixed-rate time charter and bareboat charter agreements.

changes.text: In 2023, the company entered the drybulk sector through an acquisition of drybulk vessels, creating a second reporting segment.
changes.evidence: Following our acquisition of drybulk vessels in 2023, for management purposes, we have two reporting segments (1) a container vessels segment and (2) a drybulk vessels segment.
